variables.Income_Centered: Assignment score centered at zero; negative is eligible
variables.Age: Household average age; measurement timing not established here
variables.Education: Household average years of education among people aged 16+; 51 missing

gov_transfers.sample: All 1,948 teaching observations, already restricted to approximately +/-0.02 around zero. Covariate checks use variable-specific complete cases.
gov_transfers.citation: Manacorda, Miguel and Vigorito (2011), Government Transfers and Political Support

variables.Income_Centered: Assignment score; dedicated larger sample for density diagnostics

gov_transfers_density.sample: 52,549 records before restricting to abs(Income_Centered) < 0.02 for the density exercise; not interchangeable with the outcome survey.

variables.qob_minus_kw: Birth quarter centered at the Korean War cutoff; half-integer support, no zero; veteran status falls across zero
variables.vet_wwko: Veteran of World War II or the Korean War, binary

mortgages.sample: All 214,144 records are loaded; primary analysis keeps abs(qob_minus_kw) < 12 and complete score, veteran-status and ownership values. Sensitivity windows: 6 and 9 quarters. Unadjusted local models use identical samples, controls and weights for both stages.
mortgages.citation: Fetter (2013), How Do Mortgage Subsidies Affect Home Ownership? Evidence from the Mid-Century GI Bills
